CustomField.description: Field used by business to prevent the P&G address from being updated from the primary locaiton address
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Unchecked (default) will cause address, phone and fax fields to be updated from associated Primary Location record. If no Primary Location record specified, address, phone and fax fields will be cleared. Checked will not override those fields.
CustomField.label: Do Not Update From Primary Location (OH)
